stages.title: Reporting & Intake
stages.purpose: Receive information, triage risk, preserve immediate safety.
quality_controls: Record time, source, and exact phrasing where possible

stages.title: Initial Response
stages.purpose: Stabilize scene, ensure safety, begin documentation.

stages.title: Investigation
stages.purpose: Collect facts, evidence, statements, and reconcile contradictions.
quality_controls: Hypothesis testing: actively seek disconfirming evidence
Avoid tunnel vision; maintain alternative explanations

stages.title: Charging Decision (Conceptual)
stages.purpose: Assess whether facts support charges under relevant law.
quality_controls: Check completeness: missing witnesses, missing logs, missing dates

stages.title: Adjudication (Conceptual)
stages.purpose: Court process: motions, trial, plea negotiations, judgments.

stages.title: Corrections & Reentry (Conceptual)
stages.purpose: Sanctions, supervision, rehabilitation, and reintegration support.
quality_controls: Risk/needs assessments used cautiously and audited for bias
